```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# =====================================================================
# Region-discriminator removal check
#
# R Markdown version
# - Original style retained
# - Reads exported QIIME2 feature-table.tsv directly
# - No qiime2R required
# - No biom command required
# - Saves both PDF and SVG
#
# Ranks ASVs by how strongly their prevalence differs ACROSS the three
# regions, then strips the top-k discriminators and tracks whether each
# region's intra-inter Jaccard excess collapses toward 0.
#
#   concentrated structure -> excess drops after removing few markers
#   diffuse structure       -> excess decays slowly
#
# NOTE:
# This characterizes regional structure.
# It does NOT prove contact-driven sharing.
# =====================================================================

required_pkgs <- c("vegan", "svglite")

for (pkg in required_pkgs) {
  if (!requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) {
    install.packages(pkg)
  }
}

suppressMessages(library(vegan))
```

# 1. User parameters

```{r parameters}
## ------------------------- USER PARAMETERS ---------------------------
asv_table_path <- "inputs/exported_clustering_table/feature-table.tsv"
metadata_path  <- "inputs/clustering_meta.txt"
taxonomy_path  <- "inputs/taxonomy.tsv"  # best-effort taxonomy annotation

sample_id_col  <- NA
region_col     <- "category"

table_features_as_rows <- TRUE

do_rarefy      <- TRUE
min_depth      <- NA

detect_thr     <- 0.001

max_per_region <- 300

k_grid         <- c(0, 10, 25, 50, 100, 200, 400)

n_perm         <- 150

seed           <- 1
out_dir        <- "results"
## --------------------------------------------------------------------

set.seed(seed)
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

# 2. Helper functions

```{r helper-functions}
read_tsv_table <- function(path, far = TRUE) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    stop("Feature table not found: ", path)
  }

  first <- readLines(path, n = 1)

  skip <- if (grepl("^# Constructed", first)) {
    1L
  } else {
    0L
  }

  df <- read.table(
    path,
    header = TRUE,
    sep = "\t",
    quote = "",
    comment.char = "",
    check.names = FALSE,
    skip = skip,
    row.names = 1,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  m <- as.matrix(df)
  storage.mode(m) <- "numeric"

  if (!far) {
    m <- t(m)
  }

  m
}

read_metadata <- function(path) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    stop("Metadata file not found: ", path)
  }

  lines <- readLines(path)

  lines <- lines[!grepl("^#q2:types", lines)]

  con <- textConnection(lines)
  on.exit(close(con))

  read.table(
    con,
    header = TRUE,
    sep = "\t",
    quote = "",
    comment.char = "",
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

pair_excess <- function(M, rv, k) {
  inR <- which(rv == k)
  outR <- which(rv != k)

  sub <- M[inR, inR, drop = FALSE]

  intra <- sub[upper.tri(sub)]
  inter <- c(M[inR, outR])

  c(
    med_intra = median(intra),
    med_inter = median(inter),
    excess = median(intra) - median(inter)
  )
}
```

# 3. Load table and metadata

```{r load-data}
## ---- load + align ----

feat <- read_tsv_table(
  asv_table_path,
  far = table_features_as_rows
)

meta <- read_metadata(metadata_path)

dim(feat)
head(meta)
```

# 4. Match sample IDs

```{r match-samples}
if (is.na(sample_id_col)) {
  cand <- c(
    "sample_id",
    "sample-id",
    "sampleid",
    "SampleID",
    "#SampleID",
    "id",
    "ID"
  )

  hit <- cand[cand %in% colnames(meta)]

  if (!length(hit)) {
    stop(paste(
      "set sample_id_col. cols:",
      paste(colnames(meta), collapse = ", ")
    ))
  }

  sample_id_col <- hit[1]

  message("Using sample-id column: ", sample_id_col)
}

if (!(region_col %in% colnames(meta))) {
  stop(paste(
    "region_col not found. cols:",
    paste(colnames(meta), collapse = ", ")
  ))
}

meta <- data.frame(
  sample_id = trimws(as.character(meta[[sample_id_col]])),
  region = trimws(as.character(meta[[region_col]])),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

colnames(feat) <- trimws(colnames(feat))

common <- intersect(colnames(feat), meta$sample_id)

if (!length(common)) {
  stop("no overlapping sample ids")
}

cat(sprintf(
  "Samples table=%d metadata=%d overlap=%d\n",
  ncol(feat),
  nrow(meta),
  length(common)
))

feat <- feat[, common, drop = FALSE]
meta <- meta[match(common, meta$sample_id), ]

counts <- t(feat)
counts <- counts[rowSums(counts) > 0, , drop = FALSE]

meta <- meta[match(rownames(counts), meta$sample_id), ]

dim(counts)
head(meta)
```

# 5. Subsample per region

```{r subsample-per-region}
set.seed(seed)

keep <- unlist(
  lapply(split(seq_len(nrow(counts)), meta$region), function(ix) {
    if (length(ix) > max_per_region) {
      sample(ix, max_per_region)
    } else {
      ix
    }
  })
)

counts <- counts[keep, , drop = FALSE]
meta <- meta[keep, ]

reg <- factor(meta$region)

cat("Samples per region:\n")
print(table(reg))
```

# 6. Rarefaction and presence/absence

```{r rarefy-presence-absence}
if (do_rarefy) {
  depth <- rowSums(counts)

  target <- if (is.na(min_depth)) {
    min(depth)
  } else {
    as.integer(min_depth)
  }

  low <- depth < target

  if (any(low)) {
    counts <- counts[!low, , drop = FALSE]
    reg <- droplevels(reg[!low])
  }

  counts <- rrarefy(counts, sample = target)

  cat(sprintf("rarefied to %d\n", target))
}

relab <- sweep(counts, 1, rowSums(counts), "/")

pa <- (relab >= detect_thr) * 1L
pa <- pa[, colSums(pa) > 0, drop = FALSE]

levs <- levels(reg)
regv <- as.integer(reg)

cat("Final samples per region:\n")
print(table(reg))

dim(pa)
```

# 7. Region discrimination score per ASV

```{r region-discrimination}
## ---- region discrimination per ASV ----
# Prevalence variance across regions

prevM <- sapply(seq_along(levs), function(k) {
  colMeans(pa[regv == k, , drop = FALSE])
})

# Ensure matrix has ASV rows and region columns
rownames(prevM) <- colnames(pa)
colnames(prevM) <- levs

disc <- apply(prevM, 1, var)

ord <- order(disc, decreasing = TRUE)

head(data.frame(
  ASV = names(disc)[ord[1:min(10, length(ord))]],
  disc_var = disc[ord[1:min(10, length(ord))]]
))
```

# 8. Permutation helper

```{r permutation-helper}
perm_p_region <- function(M, rv) {
  mdiff <- function(rr) {
    sapply(seq_along(levs), function(k) {
      inR <- which(rr == k)
      outR <- which(rr != k)

      if (length(inR) < 3) {
        return(NA)
      }

      sub <- M[inR, inR, drop = FALSE]

      mean(sub[upper.tri(sub)]) - mean(M[inR, outR])
    })
  }

  obs <- mdiff(rv)

  null <- matrix(NA, n_perm, length(levs))

  for (p in seq_len(n_perm)) {
    null[p, ] <- mdiff(sample(rv))
  }

  sapply(seq_along(levs), function(k) {
    (1 + sum(null[, k] >= obs[k], na.rm = TRUE)) /
      (sum(!is.na(null[, k])) + 1)
  })
}
```

# 9. Sweep over top-k discriminators removed

```{r discriminator-sweep}
## ---- sweep over k removed ----

res <- data.frame()

for (k in k_grid) {
  drop_idx <- if (k > 0) {
    ord[seq_len(min(k, length(ord)))]
  } else {
    integer(0)
  }

  pa_k <- if (length(drop_idx)) {
    pa[, -drop_idx, drop = FALSE]
  } else {
    pa
  }

  good <- rowSums(pa_k) > 0
  rv <- regv[good]

  M <- 1 - as.matrix(
    vegdist(
      pa_k[good, , drop = FALSE],
      method = "jaccard",
      binary = TRUE
    )
  )

  ex <- t(
    sapply(seq_along(levs), function(r) {
      pair_excess(M, rv, r)
    })
  )

  pp <- perm_p_region(M, rv)

  res <- rbind(
    res,
    data.frame(
      k_removed = k,
      region = levs,
      n_asv = ncol(pa_k),
      med_intra = ex[, "med_intra"],
      med_inter = ex[, "med_inter"],
      excess = ex[, "excess"],
      perm_p = pp
    )
  )
}

write.csv(
  res,
  file.path(out_dir, "region_discriminator_sweep.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

res
```

# 10. Plot excess vs top-k ASVs removed

```{r plot-sweep, fig.width=7, fig.height=5}
## ---- plot excess vs k removed ----

cols <- c("#377eb8", "#4daf4a", "#e41a1c")

yr <- range(res$excess, na.rm = TRUE)

draw_discriminator_sweep_plot <- function() {
  par(mar = c(4.5, 4.5, 3, 1))

  plot(
    NA,
    xlim = range(k_grid),
    ylim = yr,
    xlab = "# top region-discriminating ASVs removed",
    ylab = "intra - inter excess (median Jaccard)",
    main = "Does regional excess collapse when markers removed?"
  )

  abline(
    h = 0,
    col = "grey60",
    lty = 2
  )

  for (i in seq_along(levs)) {
    d <- res[res$region == levs[i], ]

    lines(
      d$k_removed,
      d$excess,
      col = cols[(i - 1) %% 3 + 1],
      lwd = 2,
      type = "b",
      pch = 19
    )
  }

  legend(
    "topright",
    legend = levs,
    col = cols[((seq_along(levs) - 1) %% 3) + 1],
    lwd = 2,
    pch = 19,
    bty = "n",
    cex = 0.9
  )
}

# PDF 저장
pdf(
  file.path(out_dir, "region_discriminator_sweep.pdf"),
  width = 7,
  height = 5
)
draw_discriminator_sweep_plot()
dev.off()

# SVG 저장
svglite::svglite(
  file.path(out_dir, "region_discriminator_sweep.svg"),
  width = 7,
  height = 5
)
draw_discriminator_sweep_plot()
dev.off()

# R Markdown 화면 출력
draw_discriminator_sweep_plot()
```

# 11. Top discriminators and taxonomy annotation

```{r top-discriminators}
## ---- top discriminators + best-effort taxonomy ----

top <- head(ord, 50)

disc_tbl <- data.frame(
  ASV = colnames(pa)[top],
  disc_var = disc[top],
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for (i in seq_along(levs)) {
  disc_tbl[[paste0("prev_", levs[i])]] <- round(prevM[top, i], 3)
}

tax_join <- 0

if (file.exists(taxonomy_path)) {
  tx <- tryCatch(
    read.table(
      taxonomy_path,
      header = TRUE,
      sep = "\t",
      quote = "",
      comment.char = "",
      check.names = FALSE,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (!is.null(tx)) {
    colnames(tx)[1:2] <- c("ASV", "Taxon")

    disc_tbl$Taxon <- tx$Taxon[match(disc_tbl$ASV, tx$ASV)]

    tax_join <- mean(!is.na(disc_tbl$Taxon))
  }
}

write.csv(
  disc_tbl,
  file.path(out_dir, "region_top_discriminators.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

head(disc_tbl, 20)
```

# 12. Final report

```{r final-report}
## ---- report ----

cat("\n===== EXCESS vs MARKERS REMOVED =====\n")

for (r in levs) {
  d <- res[res$region == r, ]

  cat(sprintf(
    "  %-13s excess: k=0 %+.4f (perm %.3f)  ->  k=%d %+.4f (perm %.3f)\n",
    r,
    d$excess[1],
    d$perm_p[1],
    max(k_grid),
    d$excess[nrow(d)],
    d$perm_p[nrow(d)]
  ))
}

cat(sprintf(
  "\nTop-50 region discriminators -> region_top_discriminators.csv (taxonomy join: %.0f%%)\n",
  100 * tax_join
))

if (tax_join < 0.5) {
  cat("  (low join: clustering_table ASV ids differ from taxonomy file; ids reported instead)\n")
}

cat("Full sweep -> region_discriminator_sweep.csv | plot -> region_discriminator_sweep.pdf/.svg\n")

cat("\nRead:\n")
cat(" if Jungang excess falls to ~0 after removing few markers -> concentrated indicator taxa;\n")
cat(" if it persists across the grid -> diffuse community-wide regional difference.\n")
```
